source: OpenMapTiles water layer, served by OpenFreeMap (the Ocean Map basemap); © OpenMapTiles © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
method: zoom-10 tiles all ocean are water, tiles without ocean are land; tiles with both read at zoom 11. Ocean class only. Within one cell of a C-HARM ocean cell simplified to 8 m, elsewhere to 40 m. Cut to the domain.
encoding: polygons -> rings (outer ring, then holes) -> [x0, y0, dx1, dy1, ...] in Web Mercator units of 1/quant world width, y down
